summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin, per the spec. Nothing was run; verification was by reading only. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: added Update(prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the early exit; the non-empty path returns Update(prologue, res); imports Update; docstring updated. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; docstring updated. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: added prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) mirroring prepareQuery, with _original_args; processUpdate and the update processor's logic are unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py (new): covers prepare+Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs prefixes, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, a no-mutation snapshot check ([name, str(op)] lists), empty requests, declarations-only prefix binding, and empty strings. Not verified: no tests run, black not run; the initial-bindings test is the most likely to need adjustment. Nothing committed.
